name: ModelMeasure
description: Represents a single ModelMeasure object in the ModelMeasures collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The name of the model measure. Read/write String.

properties.name: AssociatedTable
properties.description: Specifies the table that contains the model measure, as displayed in the Field List task pane. Read/write ModelTable.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: The Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) formula of the model measure. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormatInformation
properties.description: The format of the model measure. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: The description of the model measure. Read/write String.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the model measure from the data model.
